comment: The first command of the game is #wipe with a count of 3. dowipe() answers ECMD_TIME, so allmain.c moveloop_core() calls rhack(gc.cmd_key) again and doextcmd() reads the extended command name again. A grid bug attacks during the first repeat; mhitu.c mattacku() calls nomul(0), which ends the count, so the second repeat never runs and the keys typed for it are read as ordinary commands. No earlier command has run cmd.c reset_cmd_vars(), so svc.context.run still holds the zero C starts it with: hack.c lookaround(), which allmain.c moveloop_core() calls before each repeat, returns at `svc.context.run == 0` without examining the squares next to the hero. A square there would stop a run. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
